name: @promptflow/mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol server that exposes your Langfuse prompts to MCP-aware clients (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Authored prompts become first-class MCP Prompts the host LLM can invoke by name.

published.note: Use this once package is published to npm

steps: cd promptflow && bun install && bunx turbo run build --filter=mcp-server
unpublished.note: Current install method until npm publish

PROMPTFLOW_TAG_FILTER.description: Comma-separated AND filter to scope which prompts the LLM sees (e.g., 'voice:greeting,lang:en')

PROMPTFLOW_LABEL.description: Default Langfuse label when no version specified

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Enables the run_prompt tool for executing prompts via OpenRouter

PROMPTFLOW_LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error

prompts.description: Every Langfuse prompt becomes an invocable MCP Prompt
features: Default values from PromptFlow compose editor config.defaults

tools.name: list_prompts
tools.description: List prompts with optional tag filter (comma-separated, AND semantics)

tools.name: search_prompts
tools.description: Fuzzy search prompts by name, tags, or labels

tools.name: get_prompt_metadata
tools.description: Inspect prompt type, versions, labels, detected variables

tools.name: render_prompt
tools.description: Substitute variables and return messages without executing

tools.name: run_prompt
tools.description: Execute prompt via OpenRouter (only registered when OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set)
